goal: Measure the (separation, flux-ratio) regime where two point sources can still be resolved.

global_settings.Q_definition: Q = F2 / F1 with F1 >= F2

Q_grid.spacing: log-uniform on [0.01, 1.0], endpoints included, descending order (1.0 -> 0.01)

global_settings.geometry: Two single-pixel sources on the horizontal mid-row. Primary source is anchored at pixel (NPIX//2, NPIX//2); secondary source sits d_pix pixels to its right.
global_settings.iteration_order: outer loop over D (ascending), inner loop over Q (descending). For each D, the inner Q sweep occupies a contiguous block of 200 images.
